example_en: Three years after her marriage, a baby boy was born to her.

definition: a volatile, crystalline ketone, C10H16O, with a strong characteristic odour, derived from the wood of the camphor tree or synthetically from pinene, used to protect fabrics from moths, in manufacturing cellulose plastics, in medicine as an irritant and stimulant and for lights to be waved before a deity.
example_en: She protected the clothes by placing camphor with them.

definition: a slender, metal pin used by devotees to pierce from oneside of the cheek to the other passing through the mouth, as a vow.
example_en: The devotee had the vow-pin pierced through his cheeks.

definition: an increasing or becoming increased; growth; an increase; the quality of big, great or large.
example: ಬೆಳೆಯ ಇಳುವರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಗಣನೀಯ ಪೆಚ್ಚು ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: This year a considerable increase was seen in the crop yield.

definition: the tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpinaceae family with yellow flowers and brown pods with an acid pulp; tamarind tree.
example: ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಂಚ ಮರವು ದಟ್ಟ ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The tamarind tree in the courtyard gives thick shade.

definition: a cloth contrivance usu. shaped like an umbrella when expanded, and used to retard the falling speed of a person or thing dropping from an airplane, etc. a parachute.
example_en: The soldier's parachute did not open properly.

definition: a plane figure with six angles and six sides; a hexagon.
example_en: The math teacher explained the properties of a hexagon.

definition: complete trust; faith; belief.
example: ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ನರ್ಚು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: She had complete faith in him.

definition: to talk; to speak.
example_en: He spoke boldly in the assembly.

definition: a bitter enemy.
example_en: He is my bitter enemy.

definition: deciding a law case in accordance with the findings of evidence and inquiry.
example: ನ್ಯಾಯನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕ ತೀರ್ಪನ್ನು ಪುರಾವೆಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The judge gave a decisive verdict based on the evidence.

definition: an official building housing eighteen different chief departments of the government.
example_en: All the departments of administration are in the official building of eighteen departments.

definition: a film actor or actress (esp. who has fame).
example_en: That film star acted in the new movie.
